purpose: Repair an order-dependent exact-quote scoring defect without changing or rerunning either retrieval arm, then rescore the immutable Batch C and Batch B source-routing reports.

observedDefect.evidence: Both required child ranges span:health-who-terminology-2024-004-50fd4599b9553875-1#chars-99-314 and #chars-315-397 are present in both arms. The old scorer concatenates candidate spans in Claim-ranking order, so unrelated spans inserted between adjacent source ranges break exact-quote matching.
observedDefect.risk: The old scorer can create false negatives when contiguous child evidence is present out of candidate order, and false positives by concatenating unrelated spans globally.

fixedAlgorithm: A required evidence item is the pair (required sourceId, normalized exactQuote); quote text from a different source cannot satisfy it.
Resolve each candidate evidenceSpanId to its persisted base span and char interval.
Group candidate intervals by base span, sort by source character position, and merge only overlapping intervals or intervals separated exclusively by whitespace in the persisted base text.
Reconstruct each merged segment from the persisted base span text, not from candidate Claim order.
A requirement matches only when one reconstructed segment from a matching source contains the normalized exactQuote.
Do not concatenate non-contiguous ranges, different base spans or different sources.
requiredTests: Adjacent child ranges match regardless of candidate order.
Whitespace-only gaps may bridge; non-whitespace gaps may not.
Identical quote text in the wrong source does not match.
A full persisted span matches normally.
Candidate order does not change the result.
prohibitions: Do not modify either immutable v1 report.
Do not rerun retrieval or alter candidateClaimIds/candidateSpanIds.
Do not change L40_STRONG or SR12_40 budgets or ranking.
Do not use answer-model feedback, Relation, Context Pack, network or model calls.
Do not treat rescoring as blind product evidence.

decisionRules.EVALUATOR_ARTIFACT_CONFIRMED: At least one old quote loss becomes a tie because both arms already contained source-correct contiguous evidence ranges, with all source metrics and candidate sets unchanged.
decisionRules.TRUE_QUOTE_RISK_REMAINS: At least one SR exact-evidence loss remains under source-bound interval reconstruction.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any frozen hash mismatch, candidate-set mutation, unmatched report/Gold question, span corpus drift, non-determinism or overwrite.
